# HEF-55 guard fixture (tests/smoke.sh, "macOS portability" rule 1b): nothing below may be reported.
# Each shape is one bash 3.2 runs correctly, or text the guard must skip. Every skipped region holds a $(
# followed by a case word that WOULD be reported if that skip were removed, so each skip is tested.

# The remedy: a function the substitution calls.
f() { case "$1" in a) echo a ;; esac; }; x="$(f a)"

# Same-line closed $( … ) then a case (shapes of hooks/lane-guard.sh, hooks/session-launch.sh, hooks/status-board.sh).
t="$(readlink "$p")"; case "$t" in /*) p="$t" ;; *) p="$(dirname "$p")/$t" ;; esac; n=$((n + 1))
if l="$(readlink "$0" 2>/dev/null)"; then case "$l" in /*) d="$(dirname "$l")" ;; *) d="$d/$(dirname "$l")" ;; esac; fi
n=$(printf '%s' "$items" | grep -c . || true); case "$key" in todo) c=$n ;; doing) c=$n ;; esac

# A $( inside a case branch.
case "$1" in
  a) v="$(echo a)" ;;
  *) v="$(echo b)" ;;
esac

# Arithmetic, then a case.
n=$((1 + 2)); case "$n" in 3) : ;; esac
x="$(echo "$((a+1))")"; case "$x" in 1) : ;; esac

# A plain ( … ) subshell and an array: a ( is not a $(.
( case "$1" in a) echo a ;; esac )
a=( $(echo 1 2) ); case "${a[0]}" in 1) : ;; esac

# << inside arithmetic is a shift, not a heredoc (an identifier operand, so a misread would swallow the rest).
n=$(( 1 << n )); case "$n" in 2) : ;; esac

# Heredoc bodies are text.
cat <<EOF
y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"
EOF
cat <<-EOF
	y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"
	EOF
cat <<'EOF'
y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"
EOF
cat <<\EOF
y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"
EOF

# A comment is text.
# y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"

# Single-quoted text.
echo 'y="$(case "$1" in a) ;; esac)"'

# Double-quoted text inside a $( … ).
x="$(echo "do case y in z) ;; esac")"
